text_to_speech: Describe the motion of electrons in AC current. Picture a tube of tennis balls. Direct current is when you take a ball and push it in one end, causing one at the other end to pop out. Alternating current is when you push a ball in one end and it pops one out the other, then push one in the other end and pop one out the former. Over time, for constant frequency AC, the total change in distance for any ball inside the tube is 0.

youtube_description:
November 2017:

Describe the motion of electrons in AC current.
Picture a tube of tennis balls. Direct current is when you take a ball and push it in one end, causing one at the other end to pop out. Alternating current is when you push a ball in one end and it pops one out the other, then push one in the other end and pop one out the former. Over time, for constant frequency AC, the total change in distance for any ball inside the tube is 0.
